def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    vals=[v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,)]
    # non-background color is the seed color; ordinary noise is another color; detect unique cell color beyond 0/noise
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=0)
    color=min(counts,key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in cells):
                for rr,cc in cells:g[rr][cc]=color
    return g

    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=0)
    color=min(counts,key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); paint=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in cells): paint.update(cells)
    for r,c in paint:g[r][c]=color

from pathlib import Path
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the rare foreground object's exact shape onto every all-zero match."""
    source = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in source for v in row if v != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(source) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points}
    h, w = len(source), len(source[0])
    paint = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and source[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                paint.update(cells)
    result = [row[:] for row in source]
    for r, c in paint:
        result[r][c] = color
    return result
'''
